findings.title: Imported feed HTML bypasses post sanitization
findings.body: This creates imported posts with `raw_html`, and `Post#cook` returns that raw value without passing it through the normal sanitization/rendering pipeline. RSS/Atom item content is external and can contain executable markup such as `<script>` or event-handler attributes, so importing a malicious feed can give every reader of the topic stored XSS. Sanitize feed content with an explicit allowlist before storing it as raw HTML, or use the normal cooking pipeline.

findings.title: Remote article retrieval can follow redirects to internal services
findings.body: The embed URL's hostname is checked against the configured host before retrieval, but `open(url)` follows HTTP redirects without revalidating the destination. A URL on the allowed host that redirects to an internal address can therefore make the application server fetch internal resources; the URL's port is also unrestricted. Validate every redirect destination and restrict schemes, ports, and private-network addresses before fetching.

findings.title: The Referer is interpolated unescaped into executable JavaScript
findings.body: `request.referer` is inserted directly into a single-quoted JavaScript string. A referring page on the configured embeddable host can use a URL containing JavaScript-breaking characters to inject code that executes in the forum's origin when the embed loads. Serialize the value as a safely escaped JavaScript string and pass only a validated origin to `postMessage`.

findings.title: Standard RSS items without a content field abort feed polling
findings.body: RSS items commonly provide their body in `description` rather than `content`; when `i.content` is nil, calling `scrub` raises and aborts the polling job. Since retries are disabled, the feed is not imported on that run, including any later items. Fall back to the available description/content field and handle items with no body.

findings.title: Post-processing jobs can run before the imported topic transaction commits
findings.body: `PostCreator#create` enqueues post-processing jobs before this surrounding `Topic.transaction` commits. A worker on another connection can run immediately, fail to find the uncommitted post, and leave imported content unprocessed. Defer job enqueueing until after the outer transaction commits, or otherwise ensure the worker cannot run before commit.
